grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 166158 and dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so every row is already a distinct record with no exact-duplicate rows to absorb; each row is one scheduled flight departure, so grain_type is transaction. No single column is unique on its own (tail_number, the highest-cardinality column, has distinct_count 3825 against 166158 rows), so the identity is a derived tuple of flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, and origin_airport, which together pin down one flight instance per NYC-origin day.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, complete with null_rate 0.0 and 181 distinct dates spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30; the finer event timestamp is carried by departure_hour_utc.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter IATA carrier code (16 distinct values such as AA, DL, UA), complete with null_rate 0.0 per the operator context noting the carrier join is complete.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Numeric flight number (1 to 8500, 2994 distinct values) that labels a specific flight rather than quantifying anything, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport IATA code restricted to the three NYC airports EWR, JFK, LGA, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as an HHMM integer (500 to 2359), a time-of-day code rather than a measure, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport IATA code spanning 100 distinct airports such as ABQ, ATL, AUS, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft tail/registration number (3825 distinct values); nullable at a 0.9154% null_rate, likely flights where the registry could not resolve the tail.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Boolean flag for a cancelled flight, complete with null_rate 0.0 and exactly two distinct values true/false.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time as an HHMM integer; nullable at 2.9388% null_rate because, per operator context, a flight that never departed keeps no actual times.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes, negative when early (range -33 to 1301), a quantity compared and aggregated across flights; nullable at 2.9388% matching dep_hhmm's nulls for flights that never departed.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time as an HHMM integer; nullable at 3.07% null_rate for flights lacking an actual arrival per operator context.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time as an HHMM integer (1 to 2359), complete with null_rate 0.0 since scheduled times are always retained.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes, negative when early (range -86 to 1272), a summed/compared quantity; nullable at 3.2981% for flights without an actual arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Minutes spent airborne (range 20 to 695), a quantity aggregated across flights; nullable at 3.2981% for flights lacking actual timing.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle flight distance in miles (80 to 4983), a summable/averageable quantity, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour component (5 to 23, 19 distinct values) of the scheduled departure, a time-of-day label not a measure, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local minute component (0 to 59) of the scheduled departure, a time-of-day label, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: Canonical UTC departure timestamp at hour resolution (samples advance in exact one-hour steps, e.g. 2013-01-01T10:00:00 through 19:00:00; distinct_count 3439 over 166158 rows is consistent with hourly buckets across the date range), used as the event time for this fact; complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier legal name from the carrier lookup join (16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc.), complete with null_rate 0.0 per the operator context's complete carrier join.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer from the registry join (34 distinct values such as BOEING, AIRBUS); nullable at 16.0426% reflecting the registry join's declared completeness floor per operator context.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model from the registry join (121 distinct values); nullable at 16.0426%, matching aircraft_manufacturer's registry-join incompleteness.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured (1956 to 2013), a label of the aircraft rather than a measure of the flight; nullable at 17.6531%, the highest registry-join null rate observed.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Seat capacity of the aircraft (2 to 450), a fixed attribute labeling the aircraft rather than a per-flight measure; nullable at 16.0426% from the registry join.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Categorical engine type (6 values such as Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet) from the registry join; nullable at 16.0426% matching the other aircraft registry fields.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name, one of the three NYC airports, complete with null_rate 0.0 per the operator context's complete origin join.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin municipality, either New York or Newark, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet (3 distinct values 13, 18, 21), a fixed airport attribute not a flight measure, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet (3 distinct values 7002, 11000, 14511), a fixed airport attribute, complete with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name (99 distinct values); nullable at 2.089% reflecting the destination airports join's declared completeness floor per operator context.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination municipality (95 distinct values); nullable at 2.089%, matching dest_airport_name's join incompleteness.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: Destination ISO region/state code (45 distinct values such as US-CA, US-FL, PR-U-A); nullable at 2.089% from the destination airports join.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet (range 3 to 6606), a fixed airport attribute; nullable at 2.089% matching the destination join incompleteness.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet (range 5076 to 16000), a fixed airport attribute; nullable at 2.089% matching the destination join incompleteness.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion/profiling capture timestamp (16 distinct values all clustered around 2026-09-02T23:25-26), not the business event time of the flight itself, complete with null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled flight departing from a New York City airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) during 2013, carrying its carrier and aircraft identity, origin and destination airport attributes, scheduled and actual timing, and delay and duration measures.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category -- its category name, time column and grain, transaction grain and identity, and every field's role -- for the deterministic modeling engine that consumes the mapping contract to generate the gold fact and its dimensions.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and gated by a validator and datacontract lint, and then reviewed and edited by a human before the modeling engine executes the approved contract to produce gold models; the mapping itself never executes anything.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or interpret is_cancelled flights -- that exclusion, if any, is left to downstream consumers; it does not resolve the aircraft registry's 16.0426%-17.6531% null rates or the destination airport join's 2.089% null rate noted in the profile; and it treats captured_at purely as an ingestion artifact rather than a business event time, since its values cluster around a single 2026 capture run rather than the flights' actual 2013 activity.
